candidates.tagline: $2.1 billion stadium — exclusive railing-view seats included.
candidates.story: The brand-new Highmark Stadium opened for its first public event on August 9, 2026, and fans discovered hundreds of seats had views obstructed by structural railings, overhangs, and frosted glass — despite sales staff assuring buyers the renderings 'weren't to scale' and there would be no obstruction.
candidates.why_funny: The Buffalo Bills spent two billion dollars on a new stadium (with $850 million from taxpayers), and still managed to sell seats that face directly into a railing.
candidates.alt: Wide-angle interior view of the new Highmark Stadium in Orchard Park, New York — the modern NFL stadium seen from above with empty seats, curved architecture, and the green field below

candidates.tagline: You bought the EV for convenience. The charger is just a pole in a parking lot.
candidates.story: On August 10, 2026, a viral clip of a man charging his EV at Walmart sparked widespread 'why can't we build chargers with covers?' complaints — Walmart's outdoor charging stations have no overhead canopy, unlike every gas station built in the last century, leaving EV drivers exposed to sun, rain, and snow.
candidates.why_funny: The future of transportation promises to be frictionless, yet the reality is standing in the rain next to a pole in a Walmart lot wondering why 1940s gas station designers managed to figure out canopies.
candidates.alt: Man standing at a Walmart electric vehicle charging station in an outdoor parking lot, no overhead canopy or weather protection visible
